comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper stop; PR-1209 flush-cuts a circuit-board lead while retaining and disposing of the offcut safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses simultaneous driver and wrench control on coupled threaded elements; PR-1209 requires nipper alignment and closure while the other gripper captures a small offcut to prevent free flight.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate scores angle accuracy, lock retention, repeated cycles, and clearance; PR-1209 scores flushness and offcut disposition, with zero for unsafe free flight and full credit for released placement in the scrap cup.
comparison.reason: Safe cutting and projectile capture are materially different from preserving a mechanical setpoint during jam-nut tightening and validating it through actuation; all versions specify the relevant thresholds.
